findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/proofstory.ts:1382-1388 stripCodeLikeTokens over-strips: its hyphen/dot token-stripping regex (/\b[A-Za-z0-9_]+(?:[-.][A-Za-z0-9_]+)+\b/g) removes the SHRINKAGE TRIGGER WORD ITSELF whenever it is hyphenated or dotted to an adjacent word, e.g. deferred-for-now, excluded-here, partial-ly, narrow-ed, remaining-work, remaining-scope. Verified live: stripCodeLikeTokens("The remaining-work was left for later.") -> "The   was left for later." no longer matches claimsShrinkage, and "deferred-for-now"/"excluded-here" strip to empty. This defeats the DONE-gate unconfirmed_single_outcome_shrinkage guard for ordinary, non-adversarial phrasing an author or LLM may naturally write (not just genuine file paths like core/partial-done-recovery.ts, which was the intended target). The adversarial verification intents for CHK-001 (sanitize-path-tokens:adversarial) and CHK-003 (remaining-breadth-decision:adversarial) required proving the sanitizer/narrowing does not become a bypass for genuine shrinkage claims, but the smoke suite (proofstory-intent-hardening-smoke.ts) has no case where the trigger word itself is hyphenated/dotted -- only cases where a file path/identifier sits NEXT TO an intact trigger word. Recommend scoping the token-stripping regex so it does not consume a segment that is itself one of the trigger words (or requires a path-shaped segment such as a slash or recognizable extension) and add smoke coverage for hyphenated-trigger-word phrasing.
findings.resolvedReason: stripCodeLikeTokens no longer strips hyphen-only tokens; only backticked spans, slash tokens, and dotted tokens are removed. RED-first smoke cases (hyphenTriggerDone deferred-for-now, hyphenExcludedDone excluded-here => gap fires; bareFileNameDone partial-done-recovery.ts => no gap) verified failing pre-fix and passing post-fix; milestone-done-gate-reconciliation smoke and milestone-status tests green. Residual (bare extensionless hyphenated file name) documented in plan.md and code comment.
